observations: A large curved form dominates the center, rendered in layered yellows and golds with a bright white-yellow bloom at the top; a row of pointed triangular shapes hangs along the lower edge.
The dark background is covered edge-to-edge in small looping and zigzag lines in blue, yellow, red, gray, and pink, forming a dense border around the central form.
A vertical white-and-dark jagged line splits the lower center, with red and black coiled lines descending from it, while a teal-and-white oval shape sits to the upper right of the main form.
reading: The gold form swells upward into a near-blinding bloom, then drops into a row of hanging points that read as both decorative and threatening. The jagged vertical split below introduces a note of rupture. Around all of this, the border scrawl hums at a smaller scale — more insistent — so the image holds two emotional temperatures at once, the dense outer field pressing against the luminous center.
